\section{Coherent transport}
In the wide-band limit
\begin{equation}
\Sigma^r(\omega) = -\frac{i}{2}\Gamma, \qquad \Gamma \equiv \Gamma_L + \Gamma_R .
\label{eq:se}
\end{equation}
\section{Dephasing}
We now add a B\"uttiker probe, so that the total width is $\Gamma = \Gamma_L + \Gamma_R + \Gamma_\varphi$.
The branching ratios then sum to one,
\begin{equation}
\frac{\Gamma_L}{\Gamma} + \frac{\Gamma_R}{\Gamma} + \frac{\Gamma_\varphi}{\Gamma} = 1 .
\label{eq:branch}
\end{equation}
